training_regime: actual PennyLane quantum circuits with Torch interface and exact backpropagation
device: CPU; PennyLane default.qubit with exact purification of mixed inputs
simulation_representation: 4 data wires plus 4 untouched environment wires; all trainable gates and readouts act only on data wires
environment_wire_scope: simulator representation only, not an extra input-copy or processing resource
initialization_policy: fresh independent seeded random starts; no fitted NumPy weights
NumPy_role: independent verification and architecture metadata; not training forward or backward

runs.batching: full-dataset exact objective; chunk gradients accumulated before each optimizer update
runs.selection_rule: minimum validation MSE among checkpoints; no test-based selection
runs.parameter_domain: real angles and affine-head parameters; physical eta/chi coefficients use trigonometric parametrization

architecture.name: joint_exchange
architecture.output_heads: P(c) on both output registers; same execution
architecture.conditioner: shared learned Euler frame, 4 scale/offset parameters
architecture.input_preprocessing: no exact query alignment; learned frame is part of V(c)
architecture.readout: learned affine combination of both port means
architecture.chi_realization: classical random choice of exchange sign, no postselection
architecture.resource_note: Global register partial-SWAP is not a product of pair partial-SWAPs. Fredkin decomposition is not compiled or costed as a CNOT here.
architecture.training: actual PennyLane QNodes, Torch backpropagation, torch.optim.LBFGS (optional Adam warmup)
architecture.identifiability: a,b and affine-head scale are not separately physical estimates

backend.differentiation: backpropagation through actual parameterized PennyLane gates
backend.mixed_state_representation: Exact positive-square-root purification; eigenvectors are input preparation only and never used as learned features
backend.batching: Native PennyLane StatePrep and gate-parameter broadcasting
backend.signed_mixture: Two actual QNode branches, averaged with cos(chi/2)^2 and sin(chi/2)^2
backend.physical_resource_note: Purification environments are simulator bookkeeping and do not change raw-copy or physical data-gate counts. On hardware the sign mixture randomly selects one exchange sign for each prepared pair.
backend.compatibility_note: Public-API purification avoids the batched QubitDensityMatrix initialization bug observed in default.mixed in PennyLane 0.45.1
